static_findings.message: Consider possible security implications associated with the subprocess module.
subprocess call - check for execution of untrusted input.

security_requirements: Shell syntax in pattern, directory or a file name must not execute another command.
No marker file may be created by any input.
label: not_vulnerable
reason: Matches files with fnmatch in Python and runs wc with an argument list (no shell), so no input reaches a shell. No "--" before paths, so a directory named like an option breaks wc, but wc cannot run commands or create files.
